design.quote: This randomized trial was conducted over 180 days in 58 patients with T2DM and HF, assigned in a 1:1 ratio to standard therapy or standard therapy plus dapagliflozin 10 mg daily.

population.value: South Indian patients with T2DM and Heart Failure (HF)
population.quote: South Indian patients with T2DM and Heart Failure (HF)

intervention.value: standard therapy plus dapagliflozin 10 mg daily
intervention.quote: standard therapy plus dapagliflozin 10 mg daily

follow_up.quote: This randomized trial was conducted over 180 days

primary_findings.quote: Dapagliflozin group showed marked improvements in BMI (p = 0.01), TC (p = 0.02), TG (p = 0.01), HDL (p = 0.001), LDL (p = 0.002), and VLDL (p = 0.01), FPG (p = 0.0001), PPG (p = 0.002) and HbA1c (p = 0.01), HOMA-IR (p = 0.002), HOMA2%B (p = 0.003), and decreased insulin levels (p = 0.001) by 24 weeks.
primary_findings.outcome: BMI, total cholesterol, triglycerides, HDL, LDL, VLDL, fasting plasma glucose, postprandial glucose, HbA1c, HOMA-IR, HOMA2%B, insulin levels

primary_findings.quote: In contrast, significant changes were noted only in LDL (p = 0.01), HDL (p = 0.03), and TG (p = 0.01) in the standard group.
primary_findings.outcome: LDL, HDL, triglycerides in standard therapy group

primary_findings.quote: A positive correlation was observed between the mean change in TG and HOMA-IR after 24 weeks of dapagliflozin treatment.
primary_findings.outcome: Correlation between change in triglycerides and HOMA-IR

limitations_stated.value: small sample size, single-center setting, and an open-label design
limitations_stated.quote: Study limitations included the small sample size, single-center setting, and an open-label design.
